summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market and AI leaders, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX and NVDA. Significant directional conviction is visible in the persistent accumulation of SPX 7000C (exp 2026) totaling over $1.5B and massive SPX 600C/7000C bets exceeding $700M. The multi-day persistence of NVDA 200C and 160C (exp 2027) totaling over $1.6B suggests institutional players are aggressively hedging or speculating on long-term semiconductor dominance. Traders should monitor SPX for volatility around the 7000 level and watch for follow-through in NVDA, as the heavy premium in long-dated calls indicates a "buy the dip" mentality for the next 12-24 months.
